q03.

**`DB` — `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go`**

The struct is declared at line 16 of that file and holds the `*sql.DB` handle plus the profile:

```16:19:/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go
type DB struct {
	db      *sql.DB
	profile *profile.Profile
}
```

`NewDB` opens a connection with the `lib/pq` driver and returns `&DB{...}` explicitly typed as `store.Driver`, which is the compile-time proof that this struct satisfies the driver interface:

```33:36:/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go
	var driver store.Driver = &DB{
		db:      db,
		profile: profile,
	}
```

Note that the name `DB` is intentionally reused across dialects — each driver package declares its own `DB` struct (`/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go` and `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/mysql.go`), so the package path is what distinguishes them. The interface methods for the Postgres one are spread across the sibling files in `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/` (`memo.go`, `user.go`, `attachment.go`, and so on), with only the connection lifecycle and size/initialization checks living in `postgres.go` itself.
